address: E Columbia Rd (Columbia Bench / East Columbia planning area), SE Boise
owner_name: Primarily Micron Technology, Inc. (I-3 industrial parcels) and J.R. Simplot Company (large rangeland tracts), plus existing Columbia Bench homeowners and county ranch families. Individual parcel owners not published by Ada County GIS.
owner_type: National semiconductor manufacturer (Micron) + privately held agribusiness corporation/family (Simplot) + residential homeowners/ranch families
ownership_since: Micron long-established on the Columbia bench (Boise since 1978); has annexed 1,140+ acres since 2022, including a new ~240-acre tract recommended for annexation in 2026. Simplot is a decades-long holder. Individual parcel dates/prices unknown.
who_they_are: Micron = Fortune 500, Boise-HQ memory-chip maker building its $15B+ ID1/ID2 fabs on this bench. J.R. Simplot Co. = Boise-based, privately held agribusiness giant (Simplot family), among the region's largest landholders. BoiseDev names Simplot and Micron as the two biggest developable-land owners in the ~6-sq-mi East Columbia area.
intent_summary: Micron actively expanding its industrial (I-3) campus east/south along Columbia Rd: second fab (ID2) with 600k-sf cleanroom plus substation and 40-ft berm on ~240 acres south of Columbia Rd (Boise P&Z recommended approval July 2026). The city eyes remaining Simplot/ranch land (R-1C, R-2, 'Planned Community' FLU) for up to ~20,000 future homes to house Micron workers, but residential buildout is STALLED: Boise fire code bars >60 homes per road without a second access and no secondary road exists.
project_status: under_construction (Micron industrial); dormant (residential planned-community component stalled)

address: 4800 S Federal Way, Boise (Gateway East urban-renewal district)
owner_name: Not publicly identified (multiple parcels; Ada County does not publish owner names). Within CCDC's Gateway East URD on Federal Way; some district land is City of Boise-owned.
owner_type: Undeveloped land-bank / industrial holdings, partly public (City of Boise)
who_they_are: Mostly vacant/agricultural parcels inside the Gateway East District (est. Jan 2019, ~3,254 acres, managed by CCDC), a city-led industrial-revitalization area SE of the airport; the City owns ~300 acres across the district.
intent_summary: FLU Industrial, zoned I-1/I-2 with MX-3 mixed-use on the Federal Way frontage (a designated mixed-use 'Pathway Corridor'). No specific approved private project for this exact parcel; intended use industrial/warehouse/distribution with potential mixed-use along Federal Way.

address: 7563 S Eisenman Rd, Boise (Gowen Business Park / Eisenman industrial corridor, Gateway East URD)
owner_name: Largely City of Boise (land acquired 2000 with former Union Pacific rail line), ground-leased to developers; private parcels include Boise's Strider Group via Red River Investments. Names not published by Ada County.
owner_type: Government landowner (City of Boise) as ground lessor + national/regional industrial developers (Boyer Company, Flint Development) and local (Strider Group)
ownership_since: City acquired the corridor + ~18 mi of UPRR track in 2000; Boyer master development agreement/ground lease March 2018; Red River sites assembled ~2021.
who_they_are: Boyer Company = Salt Lake City industrial developer building Boise Gateway Industrial Park on 159 city-owned acres by WinCo DC. Flint Development = Kansas City industrial firm developing Red River Commerce Center at 7031 S Eisenman (~1.3M sf); underlying land owned by Boise's Strider Group (Red River Investments LLC).
intent_summary: Core of the Eisenman industrial corridor within Gateway East. Multi-million-sf warehouse/distribution/manufacturing buildout: Boise Gateway (~633k sf), Red River Commerce/Logistics (~1.3M sf Class A). City also bought ~76 ac off Eisenman early 2024 (~$20M) for a water-recycling facility (paused). All industrial FLU (I-1); Airport Influence Area restricts residential.

address: 1062 E Exchange St, Boise (Gowen Business Park, SE edge of Boise Airport; Gateway East URD)
owner_name: Mix of City of Boise / Boise Airport (parcels with 'Airport' FLU) and private industrial owners; specific names not published by Ada County.
owner_type: Municipal airport/government landowner + private industrial users/developers
ownership_since: unknown (airport land long-held; private lots platted decades ago as Gowen Business Park)
who_they_are: Established Gowen Business Park industrial area on the airport's SE flank — partly airport/city-owned, partly private. Nearby anchors: AZEK/CPG International's ~50-ac, 347k-sf composite-decking plant at 1001 E Gowen; multi-tenant Gowen Business Center. Inside CCDC's Gateway East URD.
intent_summary: Industrial + Airport FLU, zoned I-1/I-2. Ongoing infill/build-to-suit for light-industrial, manufacturing, warehouse/distribution and aviation-support; scattered vacant infill lots remain. Residential barred/limited by the Airport Influence Area overlay.
project_status: built / under_construction (established park with vacant infill); residential none

address: S Supply Way, Boise (Boise Air Terminal / Gowen Field airport property and periphery)
owner_name: City of Boise — Boise Airport (Department of Aviation); airfield proper plus Idaho Army National Guard (Gowen Field) and adjacent state endowment land. Peripheral parcel owners not published by Ada County.
owner_type: Institution/government — municipal airport authority (joint civil/military use)
ownership_since: City-owned airport, long-established (Gowen Field dates to the 1940s)
who_they_are: Boise Airport (Boise Air Terminal/Gowen Field), ~5,000-ac joint-use field operated by City of Boise Dept of Aviation, co-located with the Idaho Army National Guard. Idaho Dept of Lands markets commercial ground leases on nearby state endowment land.
intent_summary: Primarily airport-operations hold with peripheral industrial ground leases. FLU Airport/Industrial/Rural (A-1, A-2, I-1, County RP). Airport rezoning/leasing fringe ag land for industrial — e.g., 75 ac near Gowen Rd approved 2022 for a 1.4M-sf park with Adler Industrial (Boise Airport Industrial Holdings LLC). New residential prohibited/restricted under the Airport Influence Area overlay.
